Announce a saved file with its size and whether it replaced one

Source: R/utils_display.R
dot-cat_saved.Rd

One notice for every function that writes a file, in the shape <subject>: <path> [<size>, new <kind>], or <subject>: <path> [<size>, replaced the existing <kind>] with the replacement marker in red. Measure existed before the file is written, since writing creates it. The notice is a .cat_message(), so suppressMessages() silences it.

Usage

.cat_saved(subject, path, size, existed, kind)

Arguments

subject

Character. Leading clause, starting with the function name, e.g. "PlotRank: the plot has been saved to".

path

Character. Output file path, printed verbatim.

size

Character. Size with its unit, e.g. "12x10 in" or "12x5 cells".

existed

Logical. TRUE when a file already occupied path.

kind

Character. Output format shown in the marker, e.g. "PDF" or "DOCX".

See also

Other console display: .cat_box(), .cat_formula(), .cat_line(), .cat_message(), .cat_step(), .cat_tb()

Examples

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
.cat_saved("the plot has been saved to", path, "7x5 in",
           file.exists(path), "PDF")
#> [2026-10-29 10:26:56]  ℹ the plot has been saved to: 
#>                          /tmp/RtmpgRL5R9/file1a9b377fd4f5.pdf [7x5 in, new 
#>                          PDF]
